contentQtextDocument.legacyJson: {"sections": [{"spans": [{"text": "Today is a hard day at Quora. We made the very difficult and painful decision to reduce the size of several teams across the company. The people leaving us are very talented and contributed large amounts to our products and our mission, and we are doing our best to support them as they look for their next roles.", "modifiers": {}}], "indent": 0, "quoted": false, "type": "plain", "is_rtl": false}, {"spans": [{"text": "For our users, I want to share why we are making this change. We operate two products: Quora and Poe. The Quora product is profitable and cash flow positive, but Poe had been funding its growth with support from Quora, and we decided that it was time for Poe to stand on its own financially and fund its own growth. This unfortunately means a smaller team working on Poe, smaller SG&A functions supporting both products, and reorganization across the company.", "modifiers": {}}], "indent": 0, "quoted": false, "type": "plain", "is_rtl": false}, {"spans": [{"text": "Our continuing team will remain focused on our mission to grow the world’s collective intelligence, through Quora, through Poe, and through future products. The world is changing rapidly with the rise of AI, and we see incredible potential to apply it to greatly improve both of our products, while maintaining financial independence for both of them through smaller, more focused teams.", "modifiers": {}}], "indent": 0, "quoted": false, "type": "plain", "is_rtl": false}, {"spans": [{"text": "I want to thank all Quora team members, both continuing and departing. And I want to thank all Quora and Poe users, especially those who contribute to our ecosystems. We will continue to do our best to serve all of you.", "modifiers": {}}], "indent": 0, "quoted": false, "type": "plain", "is_rtl": false}]}
